parts.name: Cap
parts.Basic_description: This is the cap of a pen, made of plastic, typically cylindrical and hollow to fit over the pen tip.
parts.Functional_description: The cap protects the pen tip from drying out or leaking ink and can clip onto a pocket for portability.
parts.Movement_description: It can be removed or attached to the pen body by pulling or snapping into place.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the pen, made of plastic, cylindrical in shape, and houses the ink reservoir.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main structure of the pen, providing grip and containing the ink cartridge for writing.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use, though the internal ink refill may move slightly when replaced.
